data.name: Awliyaa
data.gender_notes: Awliyaa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Awliyaa refers to the friends of Allah, those who are close to Him and seek His pleasure. The term is derived from the Arabic word 'awliya' which means 'friend' or 'ally'. The name Awliyaa carries the meaning “Friends of Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Awliyaa usually hope their child will grow to embody friends of allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Hadith, the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) said, 'My ummah will never agree upon error. And the best of my ummah are my Ahl al-Bayt.' (Ahmad 5:367). Awliyaa can be seen as those who strive to embody the qualities and actions of the Prophet and his household.
data.etymology: Awliyaa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Friends of Allah.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Awliyaa total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_english.name: Awliyaa
in_english.meaning: Friends and loved ones of Allah, close to Him
in_english.long_meaning: Awliyaa refers to those who are dear to Allah and enjoy a close relationship with Him. The term is derived from the Arabic root 'walaya,' which signifies love, support, and guardianship. In Islamic tradition, Awliyaa are the pious individuals who fear Allah and strive to follow His commandments. They are considered to be Allah's special friends in this world and the hereafter.
